# chore(hfp-023): ResearchWorkbench colour tokens and results heading

## Task

Two small `ResearchWorkbench` leftovers:
- `ResearchWorkbench.vue` has 8 hard-coded hex colours. CLAUDE.md requires custom properties from `src/styles/tokens.css`.
- Commit `a6876f9` briefly added a "Desired Outcomes / N outcomes" heading above the results (`dashboard__results-title`). The component was later restored without it. Decide whether the results area should have that heading.

## Parent Story

ResearchWorkbench follow-ups (found 2026-10-26).

## Blocked by

Nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No hex or `rgb()` literals remain in `ResearchWorkbench.vue`'s styles. Each uses an existing token, or a new one added to `tokens.css`.
- [ ] Colour contrast still meets WCAG 2.2 AA in the highlighted and selected states.
- [ ] The heading decision is made (owner). If yes: the heading is added with the outcome count, and the dashboard's heading order is still correct.

## Suggested label

`ready-for-agent` (heading decision by the owner)
